steps.text: Act Two
Greetings

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Drop your weapons and step back.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I said now!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: These guys aren't even human. No need to show mercy!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Do you copy? All targets in Sector 7 are confirmed to be 'Terracotta'!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Are they really Reunion?

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: It's a diversion. Confirm their identity first.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Chief Wei! The situation has changed!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: There's... there's more of them. Almost every squad on patrol has spotted Reunion elements!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: A- another report of a brief spike in temperature in some areas of the city. What are the monitors doing?!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: No reaction! But looking at the other numbers everything does seem normal...!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: The enemy attacked as soon as our squad approached. They did not respond to any hails. We are unable to establish communication.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: The enemy is scattered! They're weak, resistance is low, but there's lots of them!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: Is this really Reunion?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: The heat source is shifting. Find a way to track it!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: There are no breaches in the city's defenses, they couldn't have gotten in——

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Don't panic!

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Summon even-numbered formations. Worst case scenario, engage the enemy in the city. Give priority to evacuating civilians.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: The downtown area is densely populated, especially Temple Street. Have all police officers within that district focus on evacuations.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Contact the satellite cities to check if there are any breaches in the defensive lines, confirm the enemy's means of ingress, and hold firm.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Reunion should be long gone. We need to identify the enemy. Getting control of the situation is our main task. This is not the first time Lungmen has suffered an abnormal occurrence at New Year's. No need to panic.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Stand together. The L.G.D. has nothing to fear.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Apologies, Amiya, Doctor. While you have only just arrived here in Lungmen, we have no time to offer you our hospitality.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't worry. Our agreement has been in effect since the moment Rhodes Island moored.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please leave it to us. We'll assist the L.G.D.!

steps.name: Lungmen Citizen A
steps.text: W- what's with those things?

steps.name: Lungmen Citizen A
steps.text: They look familiar, but weren't they——?!

steps.name: Lungmen Citizen B
steps.text: Aiee! Over here too!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hey, get out of the way...!

steps.name: Lungmen Citizen A
steps.text: Th- thanks!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't just stand there! Listen to the announcements and go to your designated evacuation zones!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Keep to the main streets until you find the police. Hurry!

steps.name: Lungmen Citizen B
steps.text: R- right!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They don't talk. They don't bleed. It's like cutting into a sea sponge. Even their bodies disappear.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: 'Terracotta.' A fitting name.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Calling them 'Reunion' would cause unnecessary panic, Officer Ch'en. They are not flesh and blood people.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Understood. Urban districts secured.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Thank you for your efforts. Unfortunately, simply killing the enemy seems futile.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: We've been unable to discern the true nature of the 'Terracottas,' but their strength has continued to grow over the past few hours.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's hard to imagine at this scale, but could it be some kind of Arts?

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: That's what's most troubling, our Originium reaction monitors are still unresponsive. But that proves this cannot be Reunion.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...I'm absolutely sure of that.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's a disguise, just an illusion.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But this image of Reunion strutting down the streets of Lungmen...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's... disturbing.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: They are completely insulated against Originium. We had thought this impossible.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But it's happening. How did they infiltrate Lungmen?

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Our conventional methods have failed. We have no indication of how the enemy 'appeared.'

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: It is as if they've been here all along, standing in silent ranks. Charging, routing, and charging again.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Just like the tide.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll prepare our defense in accordance with the contingency plan.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Be careful.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: The L.G.D. can't afford to lose you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Whoever their master is, they're just creating illusions. Other than causing a little chaos, is there any real threat to Lungmen?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They go down in one hit.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: (These things are freaking me out.... If we don't move, they just stand there in those perfectly straight rows?)

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: (But they'll come rushing as soon as we pop our heads out.)

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: (Keep your voice down. They're very weak. Let's hurry up and find a way to get the jump on them.)

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: (——Wait, what are you doing?!)

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Hey, what are guys doing? Get back here!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: ——No! You're not with us! Who are you?!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: When did these things get in here?!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Wh- what's with your face under your helmet?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Why, what the hell are you?! Get away from me!

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: What's all the ruckus? The L.G.D. freaking out just 'cause they ran into an enemy that looks like them?

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: Get up!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: R- right! I'm so sorry!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: ...Wait, you're not Ch'en Sir. Who are you to give me orders?

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: Just roll with it.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: Where is Ch'en Sir?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: She's is organizing a defensive line for the urban districts. She's going to block off the enemy and wipe them all out.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: These things just popped out of nowhere. What makes her think that this would be the way to get rid of them all?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: This is what Chief Wei determined.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: How am I supposed to trust your judgment when you're so on edge you're slipping up left and right?

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: Ugh, I'm still dizzy.... Hey! One last question!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I have no obligation to answer to the general public. The L.G.D. is here to follow Chief Wei's orders.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: I just wanna ask, is the L.G.D. out there rumbling with people from Ursus, or like Yan folk from Jiangqi? Maybe some other heavy drinkers I'm forgetting?

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: Or are you guys running around with hooch in those canteens instead of water?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Uh.... I can't really answer that, and I really don't know....

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: Ugh. I'm just trying to live down the shame of a certain Ch'en drinking me under the table.

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: Pull yourself together! Do some stretches!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: We don't want the general public involved...

steps.name: Madame Oni
steps.text: Gah, my head... Gotta sober up... What did you just say?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Erm. I said, well... I guess there's no need to turn down help from upstanding citizens....

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: We lost the heat source. Can't our instruments trace it?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: No, no, no! Conventional monitoring doesn't work. It only uses temperature to determine a rough location, and with severe lag!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: Receiving reports from all squads, the enemy appeared out of nowhere in the city. Still no trace of Originium Arts!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: Let's rout them like we did before...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: C- contact. The Terracottas are changing again, they—— they——

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: ...What happened?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: Chief Wei! They've started learning to use weapons and, more importantly, contact with the enemy reveals unique traits in each individual....

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: It's as if they're really living people——

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: Impossible! Who could make such a realistic illusion? There must be a caster! Send out a scout team to find them!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: They've taken out our equipment! You still think they're fake? They're not illusions, they're real!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: But..... But this.... It doesn't make any sense at all!

options: Is there anything I can do to help?

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: ......Thank you for the kind words, but you need not trouble yourself.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: You've dispatched Rhodes Island's operators to assist the L.G.D. in securing the urban districts, and that is the greatest of help to us.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Is Chief Wei here——? Ahem!

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: I'm sorry! I didn't mean to...! You, you're....

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: The leader of our partner organization, Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals. I believe we can put it that way for now. 'Doctor' is the appropriate form of address.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: S-s-s-s-so sorry, Doctor! And Chief Wei, what's going on outside?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: All information on the 'Terracottas' has been disseminated to all members of the L.G.D. through the terminal.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Oh, I'm sorry, I forgot there was such a thing...

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: It- it still isn't finding that heat source? This is very strange....

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Uh oh.... Temperatures rising throughout Lungmen. We can't use thermal imaging. None of our instruments can detect the heat source itself——

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: We can't confirm that the 'Terracottas' are directly connected to the heat source. And it is likely that the defensive line will collapse if we reallocate manpower.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Wouldn't it be better to look at it the other way around?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Like, what if we took all the Originium-powered equipment in the city and turned it to max, then look for wherever we *don't* detect an Originium reaction...?

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: S- sorry, I was out of line. This isn't really my wheelhouse....

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: No... That's just crazy enough to work! Hey, how much equipment does the L.G.D. have the authority to deploy directly?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer B
steps.text: It's a lot more if you include civilian ones.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: But if we have to overload everything, all of Lungmen will be paralyzed by the time we find the heat source...

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Paralyzed...? What kind of damages are we talking about?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I don't know. Tens of millions?

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Maybe we'd b-b-b-better not do it...

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: No. Just do it.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Nian sightings have become less and less common since the development of nomadic city technology. We have not had the opportunity to study the 'Nian'.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: The L.G.D. will do whatever it takes to uncover the secret of the 'Nian,' even if it's just the tip of the iceberg.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: I trust Snowsant's judgment.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Thanks, but, but shouldn't we make careful projections before....

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: ——! Sector 4's line has been breached! I can't raise the team leader!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer A
steps.text: Other lines have engaged! There are too many enemies!

steps.name: L.G.D. Comms Officer
steps.text: All teams, keep the airwaves clear at all times. Repeat, all teams, keep the waves clear!

steps.name: L.G.D. Comms Officer
steps.text: Dynamic codes will be sent to team leaders every ten minutes! Use these to identify yourselves!

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Damn it, if it's not one thing it's another.

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Stop complaining! The rest of you, form up! Get the wounded back. Don't let them break through that barricade!

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Ugh, that really brings back some bad memories.

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: They're getting tougher. But they're no Reunion. And we beat Reunion.

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Regroup!

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: No... You- You...

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: You're..... you're supposed to be dead....

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: That's a fake, you moron! It's not that Infected. Come on!

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: C- Captain!

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Don't be *Lungmen profanity* stupid. They're all fakes! All of them!

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I know, I know, I know! But to see them again, all of a sudden like this, I——

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: You again?! I just killed you a second ago!

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: None of you have any issues to work out with your colleagues? This is a great opportunity! Dig in your heels and give 'em hell!

steps.name: Serious L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: This is as far back as we go. Are you going to let them into L.G.D. HQ?!

steps.name: Frivolous L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Yes!
Lungmen Guard Department

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Chief Wei! We've found an anomalous area on thermal imaging.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: We've got a lock on the heat source! It worked!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: But we're out of time... Some of the targets have breached our defensive lines!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Re- report! We're getting distress signals from multiple teams!

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Where's Officer Ch'en?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Officer Ch'en met up with Rhodes Island operator Amiya and are currently engaging the enemy approaching the L.G.D.!

options: You sure you don't need any help?
Why don't you let me give you a hand?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: ...Chief Wei?

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Lungmen trusts the Doctor's abilities, and since Rhodes Island operators have joined the fight, the Doctor should enjoy command authority equal to that of Officer Ch'en.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: We'll leave it to the Doctor.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: The enemy moving outside the containment zones will harm the civilian population, we have to——

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Wait, we've picked up a strong Originium reaction.... a sandstorm? This, this is——

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Special transmission incoming! It- it's Inspector Lin!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Hasn't Old Lin been retired for seven or eight years?! What's he saying?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: He- he said he tossed all the enemies who slipped out of containment into a dumpster...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: And, he still has a message for Chief Wei....

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: ...Officer Lin is a hero of the L.G.D. and we should respect his opinion.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: Big Wei, how are the greenhorns? Is this how they're doing things? Why not make a special dispensation, throw me and Little Wei into the ring and I promise we'll have this done in under ten minutes..

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: ........Chief Wei?

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: ........Heh, I miss those days, when we were all young.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: But the L.G.D. hasn't fallen so far that we need to rely on those two. Contact Officer Ch'en, and let us trouble the Doctor to command the Rhodes Island operators.

steps.name: Wei Fumizuki
steps.text: Time to fight back.

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: I told you the New Year's couplets you wrote were inauspicious. Just now I saw several faces who should not be alive.

steps.name: Mr. Wei, Ordinary Citizen
steps.text: That's my fault now? And how many times have I told you not to use those old pet names in front of the men?

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: Who is it who wears the pants around here?

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: Right. That's why *she's* Big Wei.

steps.name: Mr. Wei, Ordinary Citizen
steps.text: Whatever. So what do we do now?

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: Well, I never thought I'd live to see another Nian.

steps.name: Mr. Wei, Ordinary Citizen
steps.text: Reminiscing about our days on the force?

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: No. And my daughter isn't even home. There's no point in heading back there.

steps.name: Retiree
steps.text: Let's see what they've got in store this time around. No matter who we've become, our duty to protect the people hasn't changed.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: ...Nng... I can't feel my arms... Shit...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: These things, why do I feel like they're getting stronger....?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ally of Justice #1
steps.text: What's going on? Why are these people charging us without so much as a word?

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: I think you've got it a bit twisted, Waai Fu. I'm afraid these aren't quite 'people,' you know?

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: They're more like ghosts, or something?

steps.name: Ally of Justice #1
steps.text: G- ghosts or whatever wouldn't go down this easy, would they?

steps.name: Full-time Security Guard
steps.text: Legend has it that as the New Year approaches, all kinds of monsters will come out to plague the people. Could be something like that.

steps.name: Ally of Justice #1
steps.text: Monsters can be seen and touched! Ghosts can't!

steps.name: Full-time Security Guard
steps.text: You say that, but he vanished right as you kicked him...

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: Huh? Where are you pulling us all of a sudden? And you're looking kind of stiff, Waai Fu.

steps.name: Ally of Justice #1
steps.text: Take heart.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: You civilians should be in your designated evacuation zone. It isn't safe here!

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: You're hurt, Ah Sir. Your right arm is broken and you've lost a lot of blood. It's at least an hour and a half walk from here to the L.G.D. Can you handle it?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Ugh.... I'm fine....

steps.name: Full-time Security Guard
steps.text: Aak, you better not...

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: If I might speak freely, I come from a long line of doctors. And since childhood I have taken it upon myself to save lives and care for the wounded. Whenever I encounter some excitement on the street, I always rush to see if I can be of aid——

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: W- what are you doing?

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: ——Stopping your bleeding, dressing the wound, applying anaesthetic, giving you a whole new lease on life.

steps.name: Full-time Security Guard
steps.text: That last one sounds a bit overboard.

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: It's under control. Come now, Ah Sir, how often do you get a shot at free health care?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I really appreciate it, but there's something off about y——OW! Hands off! Hey!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: What was that drug? Are you licensed? Show me your papers, or else——

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: ——Ah.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Heh, heh? The pain's actually gone...?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: And what's that fruity smell....?

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: The new stuff is watermelon flavored. Congratulations on being the first to try it!

steps.name: Full-time Security Guard
steps.text: Why would you have watermelon flavored injections?

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: Honestly, the pain relief is just a placebo effect. Your bleeding has stopped, and you'll certainly have no trouble returning to the L.G.D. in one piece.

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: Once there, do remember to get formal medical treatment, as a simple debridement will not solve the problem, and there is no way to know what substance caused the wound.

steps.name: Full-time Security Guard
steps.text: ........Did you just admit you're informal?

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: This is an emergency!

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: Let's get you up, Ah Sir. You're all right.

steps.name: Watermelon-scented L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I really do feel all right...

steps.name: Watermelon-scented L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Thank you very much, and I'll report this assistance to my superiors when the battle is over!

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: No, no, no, let's not go reporting things. Safe travels, Ah Sir. Take care!

steps.name: Watermelon-scented L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: ...What a weirdo.

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: Whew! And that's my good deed for the day!

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: Experimental Epinephrine Reagent No. 3.... Effective..... No short-term adverse effects.... Continuous observation.... Smells of watermelon, origin unknown.... And that's that!

steps.name: Ally of Justice #1
steps.text: Origin unknown?

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: Tried it, it worked, it didn't kill anyone, that's what I call good medicine!

steps.name: Ally of Justice #1
steps.text: Good thing it worked, or we'd have to knock you out and hand you over to the L.G.D. to calm things down.

steps.name: Full-time Security Guard
steps.text: Those ghosts are making trouble all over the place. Is that why Mr. Lee had us out on the street all of a sudden?

steps.name: Ally of Justice #1
steps.text: I definitely don't want to give up the streets to them, but if it's g-g-g-ghosts.... What can you do? You can't punch or kick them.

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: But you just——

steps.name: Ally of Justice #1
steps.text: You can't fight a ghost with your fists! It can't be done! No way! I can't do it!

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: You were doing that literally two minutes ago...

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: Well, I've been short of work lately, so why not just leave them to make some patients?

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: Like a bicycle repairman who leaves nails out on the street.

steps.name: Full-time Security Guard
steps.text: Keep going down the path of wickedness and you'll get what's coming to you.

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: I'm not worried. I know far too many happy, healthy people who've earned a comeuppance. My turn is a long way off.

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: By the way, Hung, aren't you curious about the 'Nian'?

steps.name: Full-time Security Guard
steps.text: I just want everyone to be safe and sound.

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: You're! So! Dull! What about Waai Fu? Want to sneak into the containment zone and take a look?

steps.name: Ally of Justice #1
steps.text: I won't stop you, but I'll tell Mr. Lee all about it.

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: Don't you want to go toe to toe with a literal legend? Bam! Pow! Bang! Uppercut! I've heard the Nian is a tough, bloodthirsty demon. One you can actually see and touch!

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: Ah. And if you defeat the Nian, your old man, in pursuit of the ultimate truth of martial arts, would finally be willing to fight you. And then, at long last, father and daughter communicate with their fists, reconciling once and for all! What a beautiful story....

steps.name: Back-Alley Doctor
steps.text: Hey, Waai Fu, I was just kidding, don't be like that.... Wait, Waai Fu, where are you going...? Oh, no! Hung! Stop her!

steps.name: Child
steps.text: ——Mom?

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Mister.... Have you seen my mom?

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Mister?

steps.name: Child
steps.text: ——Mmh, hot!

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Lady, where did that man go?
It's probably not a good idea to let a guy like that, silent and armed to the teeth, around kids, huh?

steps.name: Child
steps.text: But Mom told me to find a policeman if I got lost...
You don't have to do everything your mom says.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: But...
No buts, little one. We've got the battle of the century going on out here. You run along and play somewhere else.

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Um, okay.... Thank you, lady!
What a good kid.
Hmmm...?
Isn't a sweet little show like that supposed to make you think, 'Oh, maybe she's not so bad,' and lower the dagger?
Is one woman supposed to be able to wear out the entire L.G.D.?
I'm not one to mince words, so let's get right to it. You're no ordinary warrior. What's your name?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Lava.
What's with people these days? That can't be your name. It's too weird.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It's my codename.
That's kind of a pain. What's the difference between a name and a codename anyway? Is it really so important to express your identity as an independent organism?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You're the one who asked!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Besides, there's no way you could understand us, 'Nian'.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Wow, you recognized me right away.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: That's what they used to call me, but I don't think 'Nian' is cool enough. Can we change it? I want a badass codename like 'Lava.'

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: ...You won't get away, the L.G.D. can track you.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I don't have to run. Come, Tinmen.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: This is the weapon you took from the Lungmen central database.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What can you do with such weak illusions?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oooh - you cut through the air with a dagger? I've never seen Arts like that before. Pretty badass!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Thanks for the compliment. Should I teach you?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ho ho ho——not bad.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I didn't expect to see a massive moving metropolis. You people have some tricks up your sleeves.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: And your Arts, well, I've never seen such a skillful and practical approach before.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: It's a relief. I was afraid you wouldn't have made much progress.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You used the data in those records to create illusions of Reunion and the L.G.D.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Your power is not like Originium Arts, but you can't fool me. Now that I have you figured out, the monsters that have plagued Lungmen for centuries will be no more.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You're a smart cookie. Where'd you come up with this stuff?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I've been combing ancient records and modern papers in a quest to understand you.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Huh? So all the years I've been sleeping, you've been cramming trivia about me?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Pretty much.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I was born and bred to hunt your kind.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Wha? So you're like, a fan of mine?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: ...If wanting to kill you counts.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I never thought I'd meet someone like you.... before I forgot myself.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, honey, I'm touched. I'm on the verge of tears here. It's like I'm a forgotten has-been meeting an old fan. How about it? Why don't we call a truce and go get a drink?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Since we're waiting for the Tinmen to overpower the... oh, what are they called again...? That's right! Since we're waiting for the Tinmen to beat down the L.G.D., we might as well find something to pass the time.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: ...According to the records, it's been decades since you last attacked Lungmen.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You have no idea what we're capable of now, and you're still so sure of yourself?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What are you capable of? You've got taller buildings, a bit more metal in your machines, and your hot pot tastes worse...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What should I be worrying about? What else can you show me?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You seem to be looking forward to it.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: That I am.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You'll see. Let's call it... divination.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: They're allowing divination these days? Time was, a commoner would be put to death for seeking knowledge of the heavens.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: If divination's a crime, then I'm guilty as charged.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You....

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I'm even more curious about you. You sure you don't want that drink?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Then make those things stop.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Is this like a 'surrender now and I'll let you live' thing?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I care more about the truth than fighting you.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: The truth? What do you want to know? Seeing as we're so in tune with each other, I might consider telling you.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Your goal. And how to defeat all of you once and for all.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: All of us?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Nian is only your name. The Catastrophe is far more than just you, I know that well.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What are you going to do when you know the answer? Still going to be all fighty-killy?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Yeah. Maybe. If your true form can actually be killed.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (There's a change in her attitude... A pressure in the air...)

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hey, li'l Lava.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Don't call me that. We're not friends.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Don't say that, you really surprised me, you've learned a lot more than I ever expected.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You're right, you know. At first, I wasn't planning to do anything to this city. As far as I was concerned, you were weak little folk, gradually making your way in the world.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But I have to admit, you made some real progress over the years.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: And to think someone's actually been watching us all this time. That's a pleasant surprise.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You left behind horror stories and monster myths in every corner of the world. How could we not look for you?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Sometimes it was a giant, sometimes it was an army, sometimes it was Arts like a Catastrophe...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: But we always grew stronger, in order to survive.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What I don't understand is how the people of ancient Yan fought with spears and halberds, while Lungmen today has huge cannons to protect the city, and in the end they all suffered the same fate?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Were you going easy back then? Or are you stronger now?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Or——

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You need juuust the right amount of destruction and mayhem to make a point.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Isn't this fun? I wake up to find that the little ones who haven't changed in years are suddenly so close to the truth.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I think it's time to take off the kid gloves and bump up the difficulty.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You won't get away with it.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ooh, fire——?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: So the dagger was just an opening act. The staff is the headliner?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You people have never been willing to use your power efficiently. And that's one thing that hasn't changed.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: A shield...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I've never seen anything like it before. And it's suppressing the range of my Originium Arts, how did she do that...?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hey! Originium Arts? That sounds pretty badass!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (But my flames just now... She used her power specifically to block them?)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Spatial Arts are trickier.... but...)

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But I do have one teensy little question. How did you come up with all this stuff while I, or I guess 'we,' were snoozing away?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: No comment.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Is that right?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Let's change the subject then. A minute ago, you said my power was to use data to do up those toy soldiers.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Sorry, but that's a swing and a miss. How could I figure out something so complicated so quickly?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Turns out, you break stuff down into its simplest parts, language, Arts, anything, and it's all pretty much the same.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: And the best possible material I could find was that data. Your past enemies, your fears and anxieties. It's perfect for having a little fun.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Think of it like blowing bubbles in the park.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: ...What are you trying to say?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: When you said you had me figured out, I got this warm, tingly feeling.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I wonder if it's true.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: How... The top of that building... it's melting?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Relax. All the people are gone.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: ...What are you going to do?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Smelt. Cast. Temper.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: This city will make the perfect forge.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Li'l Lava, don't you think you'd make a good blacksmith?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Who wants to be a blacksmith?!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Hrm, it's just like in those theses. They were so out there, I never thought they could be true. But the Nian can pull off some incredible feats without using Arts, in the traditional sense.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Now, just like the conclusions of those papers... I have to try this.)

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh? The dagger slices through the air and compresses it. Is this how you use those Originium Arts?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: None of the records or studies give any indication of your true form. It took long enough to determine that you were actually a communal organism rather than a single individual.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: But that begs the question, why am I standing here?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Cover your ears, Nian.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ugh.... That noise...!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: 'The heart of the crucible is... nothing but straw!'

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Gah——That's——

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Never thought I'd see you cowering.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Who the hell are you?! How do you know about that——

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ahhhh.... No... I know all too well who's behind this...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Shit. How much did Hsi tell the humans——

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Surprised?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Countless researchers have spent countless years going over every record they could get their hands on, and still not one could find even a shred of hope to combat the Nian.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: But there are many ancient legends in the land of Yan, and the ones that don't concern you have interesting bits to them.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Legends?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Old folk sayings like 'the din of fireworks rings in the new year' and such.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ahhh....

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: So that's how it is.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I guess these things turn into legends to be passed down through the centuries, even if you don't understand their true meaning.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: In a world plagued by Catastrophe, you find a way to keep things going. Isn't that nice?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I'll put a little more thought into it.... Let's build something a bit less boring.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: She closed her eyes?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Wait, she's taking something out of her mouth... it's... a sword?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Slow on the uptake. And don't distract me. What if I choke?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: The spatial Arts... you cut it open?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Is that so surprising? Just cut right into it. You can't do that?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: *Sigh*. Never enough respect for the time-honored crafts. Always after some kind of boring old embroidered pillow or whatever.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Then let's have you feel the weight of history.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Guh!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, sorry. Was that too heavy for you? Hey! Are you still alive?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: So this is the power of the 'Nian,' huh? I'm not impressed.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Come on, that was pretty hard, wasn't it? Don't try to act tough here.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It's fine. I already know how to beat you. Aren't you at least a little shocked?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: If nothing else because I'm actually putting up a fight?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...Ha. I think someone's getting too big for her tattered britches.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: ——The ground, no, the world is shaking. Does this city mean anything to you?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: It's overkill, isn't it? Just to deal with you?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I'm only trying to see the best you humans have come up with. And passing the time, I guess.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: How long can you keep fighting? Ten minutes? An hour? A whole day?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Until I unravel the mystery of your trickery.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You're dreaming! How can a simpleton like you perceive that which is beyond your world?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: She pointed to the sky...?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: 'Heavenly forge, take the bounty of the earth and smelt an edge to slice the sky!'

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Arise!
